full_text_en:
Wang Xiaodong — Robbery, Hooliganism, and Theft Case

Defendant: Wang Xiaodong, male, 22 years old, native of Beijing. Worker at the Thin Plate Factory of Special Steel Company, Capital Iron and Steel Corporation. Arrested on May 26, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Song Dejia, lawyer from Beijing Economic Law Firm.

The Branch of Beijing People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution against defendant Wang Xiaodong for robbery, hooliganism, and theft before the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court. The Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court found after trial:

At approximately 5:00 p.m. on January 23, 1996, the defendant Wang Xiaodong, together with Kang Jianping (separately prosecuted), went to make a phone call at a public telephone booth south of Gucheng No. 2 Primary School in Shijingshan District, Beijing. Kang Jianping forcibly hung up the phone being used by Cao Zhengfei (male, 30 years old). Subsequently, Wang Xiaodong and Kang Jianping beat Cao Zhengfei and attempted to rob him of his ring, but the robbery was unsuccessful due to Cao's resistance. At approximately 6:00 p.m. that same day, Wang Xiaodong and others went to the north side of Building 14, Bajiiao South Road, Shijingshan District, to seek an opportunity for robbery. At that time, Lü (female) happened to pass by. Wang Xiaodong approached and snatched Lü's backpack. When Lü chased after him to demand its return, Wang Xiaodong grabbed Lü by the hair, beat her, threw her to the ground, robbed her of a gold necklace and RMB 380, and committed indecent acts against Lü. At 11:00 p.m. that same night, Wang Xiaodong went to Room 93, Unit 6, Building 10, Bajiiao South Road, Shijingshan District, broke a window to enter, and stole over RMB 33,000, over 700 US dollars, a gold necklace, gold rings, and other items from Wang Shaodong. The stolen cash and items were valued at a total of over RMB 39,000.

At approximately 1:00 a.m. on January 27, 1996, the defendant Wang Xiaodong went near the Sculpture Park in Shijingshan District to seek an opportunity for robbery. He intercepted two young women, Zhang and Liu (both from Yiyang County, Henan Province), grabbed both by the hair, and forced them to hand over money. When they said they had none, Wang Xiaodong forcibly searched Zhang and seized over RMB 120. Thereafter, Wang Xiaodong beat both women with fists and feet and committed indecent acts against Zhang.

At approximately 10:00 p.m. on May 14, 1996, the defendant Wang Xiaodong went to the garden north of Building 14, Bajiiao South Road, Shijingshan District, to seek an opportunity for robbery. He intercepted Hao (female, 29 years old), grabbed her by the hair, punched her in the face, knocked her unconscious, robbed her of a gold necklace and a gold ring, and committed indecent acts against Hao. Hao sustained a cerebral concussion and a nasal bone fracture as a result of the beating. Wang Xiaodong was apprehended at the scene after committing the crime.

The above facts are confirmed by the statements of victims Cao Zhengfei, Lü, Zhang, Liu, Hao, and the owner Wang Shaodong; the record of crime scene inspection; hospital medical certificates; the recovered stolen property from the robberies and theft; and the price appraisal certificates of stolen goods. The defendant Wang Xiaodong's confession concerning the time, place, and methods of the crimes is consistent with the above evidence.

The Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant Wang Xiaodong, showing no regard for national law, continued to engage in criminal activities even during the national campaign to severely crack down on serious criminal offenses, demonstrating an arrogant criminal demeanor. With the purpose of illegal possession, Wang repeatedly used violence to rob citizens of their property by stopping them on the road, and secretly stole citizens' property by entering residences, involving an extremely large amount. He also engaged in picking quarrels and provoking trouble and insulted women under egregious circumstances. His conduct violated Article 150(2), Article 152, and Article 160 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, constituting the crimes of robbery, theft, and hooliganism respectively. The crimes of robbery and theft he committed were both of extremely serious circumstances and posed immense social harm, warranting severe punishment according to law. The crime of hooliganism he committed was under egregious circumstances and should be severely punished in accordance with Article 1(1) of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Endanger Public Security. Wang Xiaodong committed multiple crimes, and therefore, in accordance with Article 64 of the Criminal Law, concurrent punishment for multiple crimes should be imposed. Given the nature and circumstances of his crimes, and in accordance with Article 51(1), Article 52, and Article 53(1) of the Criminal Law, additional deprivation of political rights should also be imposed accordingly. Although Wang Xiaodong confessed to some of his crimes during detention, the crimes he committed were extremely serious, and his request for a lenient sentence is not well-founded and shall not be adopted. Accordingly, on June 1, 1996, the court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Wang Xiaodong is convicted of robbery and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; convicted of theft and sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for three years; convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for two years; and it is decided to execute the death penalty, with deprivation of political rights for life.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, the defendant Wang Xiaodong appealed to the Beijing High People's Court on the grounds that he had confessed to his crimes and had exposed others' criminal activities, requesting a lenient sentence. The defense counsel for Wang Xiaodong argued that the hooligan acts were of ordinary circumstances and that the circumstances of the robbery were not particularly serious, suggesting a lenient sentence.

The Beijing High People's Court, after trial, held that: The appellant Wang Xiaodong showed no regard for national law and had an arrogant criminal demeanor. With the purpose of illegal possession, he repeatedly robbed citizens of their property by stopping them on the road, and in the course of committing robbery, he used violence causing physical injury to the victims, with particularly serious circumstances. He entered residential premises at night to secretly steal citizens' private property, involving an extremely large amount, with particularly serious circumstances. Moreover, he openly defied legal discipline and social morality, picked quarrels and provoked trouble, and insulted women under extremely egregious circumstances. Wang Xiaodong's conduct constituted the crimes of robbery, theft, and hooliganism respectively, all of which should be severely punished according to law. After being apprehended, although Wang Xiaodong confessed to some of his crimes and exposed one instance of ordinary criminal activity by others, these did not constitute major meritorious service and could not serve as grounds for a lenient sentence. The grounds of Wang Xiaodong's appeal were untenable and should be dismissed. The defense counsel's arguments that the hooligan acts were of ordinary circumstances and that the circumstances of the robbery were not particularly serious lacked factual and legal basis and were not adopted. The first-instance court's judgment, based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of social harm of Wang Xiaodong's crimes, was correct in conviction and application of law, appropriate in sentencing, and the trial procedure was lawful. The judgment should be affirmed. Accordingly, in accordance with Article 136(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, the court issued the following ruling:

Reject Wang Xiaodong's appeal and affirm the original judgment.

Pursuant to the provision of the Supreme People's Court authorizing the High People's Courts to approve some death penalty cases, the Beijing High People's Court approved the criminal judgment of the first-instance court sentencing Wang Xiaodong to death, with deprivation of political rights for life, for concurrent punishment of robbery, theft, and hooliganism.
